| description = This storm giant rules over both the Kromzek and the Kromrif clans with an iron fist. Although the giants of Velious have a close kinship with the orc, Tormax has a great many enemies. His grandfather slew Lord Yelinak's mate and the desire of his people to have supremacy over Velious has brought them into countless years of conflict with dragonkind. Also, to the west Tunare's Court battles the giants who encroach into their sacred forest. Only in the last two centuries has a new enemy come to Velious - the Coldain dwarves. Despite the benevolence of the hardy Coldain, the pugnacious giants and orcs take their arrival on the frozen continent with great displeasure.
